status: specified after v1 activation adjudication and before v2 provider access
claim_scope: Consumed-Dev instrumentation and natural activation only. No success, efficiency, generalization, leaderboard, or treatment-effect estimate.
fixed_interface_changes: remove the contradictory opening instruction that assigned installation to envbench_shell
use target subject names instead of copied obligation objects
bind each subject name to every exact active obligation in the immediate pre-measurement
unchanged_mechanism: one continuous model session and persistent construction environment
complete public-goal measurement immediately before and after the operation
supported, partially_supported, refuted, invalid_target, or inconclusive effect classification
ordinary free shell remains available for inspection and diagnosis
Minimal-B clean replay remains the only delivery primitive
provider identity remains Agent-declared rather than independently certified

fixed_episode.request_cap_role: engineering smoke limit only; noncompletion is not a paper outcome

primary_activation_endpoint: At least one valid test_constraint_hypothesis invocation occurs naturally before terminal completion or the request cap.
secondary_endpoints: the invocation targets subjects active in its immediate pre-measurement
complete before, operation, and after evidence is retained in the machine trajectory
the bounded classification is delivered before the next model request
the next reasoning turn explicitly receives or responds to the classification

decision.pass: Primary endpoint and every evidence-delivery endpoint hold.
decision.fail: No natural invocation occurs, or evidence binding/delivery is invalid.
decision.after_pass: Select a separate fixed matched Dev effect batch before either arm runs.
decision.after_fail: Reject this structured interface as the next core treatment; do not add more case-specific prompt rules.
